notes.title: Planaris 2+ Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
I've just released the first update for Planaris 2+, version 1.1! 

The major new features are:
[list]
[*] Controller support! You can now play the game with a controller in Steam Big Picture Mode... There are official bindings for both the Dualshock 4 and the Steam Controller, and other controllers should work as-well as long as you set the appropriate bindings in steam (or load community bindings setup by someone else). If you want to play the game with a controller, I'd recommend doing the tutorial again first (by selecting it from campaign mode) to learn the basics.
[*] 4 New levels added to campaign mode... Get those stars!
[/list]

Some minor changes/tweaks include:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Dedication achievement being improperly awarded.
[*] You can now navigate the menus with your keyboard.
[*] Made one of the songs that plays during gameplay a bit longer... to reduce repetitiveness.
[/list]

That's it for now... As always, if you have any feedback or find any bugs, head on over to the community forum and let me know!

notes.title: Planaris 2+ Releases on Steam July 9th!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1102080/Planaris_2/]Planaris 2+[/url], an enhanced version of the hit browser & mobile game Planaris 2, is coming to Steam July 9th!

Planaris 2+ is a tetronimo clearing game appropriate for casual game fans of all ages... It has mechanics you can learn in minutes, yet are deep enough to provide a challenge to even the most skilled gamers.

Planaris 2+ has the following enhancements over the free browser-based game Planaris 2:
[list]
[*]It's a standalone Windows application... Which means better visual fidelity, better fullscreen/4k support, and in general a better experience all around.
[*]It supports steam cloud saves, steam achievements, and steam leaderboards.
[*]A bunch of all-new levels, some of which have added mechanics such as gravity, alternating dual-color shape placement, and additional piece shapes to place.
[*]Small QoL features such as an indicator that shows you when & where the next lock will spawn.
[*]Controller support will be added in v1.1(Most likely sometime in late July-early August, with a public beta test in mid-July).
[/list]

Planaris 2+ will be on sale on Steam for $5.99 USD, with a 25% discount for one week after launch.
